**Main line:** Qc2+ Kg3 Qxd1 dxc5 bxc5

**Coaching note:**
When your opponent's pieces are loose and undefended, look for forcing moves—especially checks that displace the king. Here, Qc2+ forces Kg3, leaving the rook on d1 hanging. After you capture it, White's best try (dxc5) still leaves you with a rook for two pawns. Always calculate checks before settling on simpler moves.
